entities.summary: Marian Eleganti is a Swiss Catholic prelate who served as an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Chur from 2009 to 2021. Otmarsberg Abbey. He is a member of the Benedictines. Marian Eleganti was a religious figures from Uznach (b. 1955-04-07, Uznach). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
